clusters.headline: Parties Split Over Union Cabinet’s Amended Delimitation Bill
aiSummaryBullets: The Union cabinet approved a bill proposing to cap assembly seats at 650 while introducing rotational reservations for women.
Regional parties including the NCP (SP), DMK, and Telugu Desam Party are navigating internal debates or shifting stances on the proposed legislation.

clusters.headline: Union Cabinet Proposes 50 Percent Lok Sabha Seat Increase By 2051
aiSummaryBullets: The Union Cabinet approved legislation to expand Lok Sabha seats from 550 to 850.
A new bill mandates a 33 percent reservation for women in Lok Sabha and state assemblies beginning in 2029.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam Lighting In Tamil Nadu
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court issued contempt notices to Tamil Nadu officials regarding the failure to facilitate the lighting of a lamp on Tirupparankundram Hill.
Central Reserve Police Force personnel have been directed to oversee the Karthigai Deepam lighting ceremony to ensure compliance with court orders.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam To Be Lit At Tamil Nadu Site
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court directed that a lamp be lit at the designated site for Karthigai Deepam following non-compliance by state officials.
Judges issued contempt notices to fifteen Tamil Nadu officials and appointed former judges to oversee temple operations.

clusters.headline: FSSAI Initiates Legal Action Against Bisleri Over Bacterial Presence
aiSummaryBullets: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has started legal proceedings against Bisleri International regarding water safety.
Laboratory tests confirmed the presence of coliform bacteria in water samples collected from production facilities in West Bengal and Goa.

clusters.headline: Political Clash Intensifies Across India On Constitution Day
aiSummaryBullets: The BJP and Congress engaged in mutual accusations of undermining constitutional values during commemorations.
Union Minister Amit Shah criticized Congress leadership regarding the status of the Women's Reservation Bill.

clusters.headline: India-Pakistan U19 Cricket Match Controversy Over Neutrality
aiSummaryBullets: Observers raised concerns regarding umpire conduct during the India-Pakistan match following a celebratory gesture toward the Pakistani side.
The Indian cricket team faced criticism for opting to boycott the customary post-match handshake with the Pakistani players.

clusters.headline: TVK MLA V.S. Babu, Who Defeated M.K. Stalin, Has Passed Away
aiSummaryBullets: TVK legislator V.S. Babu has died following a 71-day period of medical treatment.
Babu previously gained political recognition for winning the Kolathur assembly constituency over M.K. Stalin.

clusters.headline: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh Arrested Over Harassment Complaint
aiSummaryBullets: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh was arrested by police following a harassment complaint filed by a woman IAS officer.
The case involves charges under the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Bihar Move To Release Anand Mohan From Prison
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court ruled that the Bihar government's decision to grant premature release to former MP Anand Mohan was illegal.
Anand Mohan was previously granted release during his sentence for a murder case, a move now overturned by the top court.

clusters.headline: Bombay High Court Allows Tata Sons Meeting Amid Leadership Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: The Bombay High Court refused to grant interim relief to Tata Trusts regarding their challenge to N Chandrasekaran's reappointment.
The court ruled that the scheduled Tata Sons board meeting may proceed as planned on November 30.

clusters.headline: At Least 24 People Killed In Bus-Truck Collision In Assam State
aiSummaryBullets: A collision involving a bus and a truck occurred in Assam, India.
The incident resulted in at least 24 confirmed fatalities.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Remains In Poor Category Following Cold Morning
aiSummaryBullets: Air quality in Delhi has remained in the poor category for nine consecutive days.
The city recorded its coldest morning of the current season as temperatures dropped.

clusters.headline: Bombay High Court Rules On Property Dispute Over Gift Deed
aiSummaryBullets: An 88-year-old father moved into an old-age home after transferring property to his son.
The Bombay High Court intervened in the subsequent dispute regarding the gifted flat.

clusters.headline: Centre Confirms Look Out Circular Issued Against Saurav Das
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian government confirmed to the Delhi High Court that a Look Out Circular has been issued against Saurav Das.
Authorities stated that document discrepancies, specifically concerning a passport, may impact his citizenship status.

clusters.headline: Sunjay Kapur Family Trust Mediation Fails In Ongoing Asset Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: Court-mandated mediation efforts to resolve the long-standing family trust dispute have concluded without an agreement.
The legal conflict involves Sunjay Kapur and centers on assets valued at approximately Rs 30,000 crore.

clusters.headline: Supriya Sule Skips INDIA Bloc Meet Over Sharad Pawar Health Issues
aiSummaryBullets: Supriya Sule announced she will miss the current INDIA bloc meeting due to Sharad Pawar being hospitalised.
The NCP MP stated she plans to travel to Delhi on November 30 to participate in the upcoming special Parliament session.

clusters.headline: Ladakh Holds Local Polls Amid Claims Of Boycott By Sonam Wangchuk
aiSummaryBullets: Ladakh recorded a voter turnout of 70% for panchayat elections and 52% for municipal council polls.
These represent the first local body elections held in the region since it was designated a Union Territory in 2019.

clusters.headline: Nandini Curd Price Reduced In Karnataka Following Public Backlash
aiSummaryBullets: The retail price for Nandini curd has been lowered by Rs 2 per kilogram.
The adjustment follows reports of public dissatisfaction regarding earlier cost increases.

clusters.headline: Yogi Adityanath Addresses Political Criticism Following Family Loss
aiSummaryBullets: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath attended his mother's final rites in Haridwar following her passing at age 91.
The Chief Minister has engaged in verbal exchanges with political rivals, including criticism directed at the Samajwadi Party.
